title: Origin story: Hercules
description: Hercules was the son of Zeus and the mortal woman Alcmene. Hera, queen of the gods, hated him from birth and sent serpents to his cradle, which the infant strangled. As atonement for a madness Hera inflicted on him, the oracle at Delphi ordered him to serve King Eurystheus for twelve years.
